title: The Wynwood Original
description: Joel and Leticia Pollock opened this flagship in 2010, long before the murals made Wynwood world-famous. Miami's local coffee scene grew up right here — come see where it started.
quest_objective: Step inside Panther's Wynwood flagship, find the panther wherever it appears, and snap a photo with it.
action_prompt: Give your best (quiet) panther growl before your first sip or your final photo.

title: Flagship of Vice City
description: Tucked between Downtown and Wynwood in the Arts & Entertainment District, this is the flagship of a homegrown three-shop Miami coffee family. Blink on N Miami Ave and you'll miss it.
quest_objective: Find Vice City Bean's flagship on N Miami Ave and claim the seat with the best people-watching.
action_prompt: Strike your most 'Vice City' pose for the camera — sunglasses optional but encouraged.

title: Donuts, Coffee, Vibes
description: The brand's own motto is 'donuts, coffee, vibes' — and the Wynwood shop is where Miami checks all three boxes. The lineup changes, which is exactly the fun of it.
quest_objective: Find today's donut lineup and photograph the flavor you'd cross town for.
action_prompt: Rank your top three flavors out loud with whoever is next to you.

title: Down Under on Giralda
description: Nick and Teresa brought Australian café culture to Coral Gables in 2014, and Giralda Avenue hasn't been the same since. Come find the Aussie accent hiding on a Spanish-named street.
quest_objective: Find Threefold on Giralda Ave and spot one unmistakably Australian touch on the menu or in the room.
action_prompt: Say 'flat white' in your best Australian accent — ordering one is entirely optional.

title: Full Throttle Coffee
description: Imperial Moto's headquarters sits in Little River — not Wynwood, as many assume — and it's the flagship of a café brand that has ridden all the way to Aventura and St. Barths. Motorcycles and espresso, together at last.
quest_objective: Find Imperial Moto's Little River headquarters and photograph the most motorcycle thing you can find.
action_prompt: Do a subtle engine rev with your wrist as you walk in. Vroom responsibly.

title: The Buddha's Gallery
description: Brothers Jordan and Cassidy Athos opened this café-meets-arthouse in Pinecrest in 2017. Half the room runs on caffeine, the other half on creativity — explore both.
quest_objective: Explore the arthouse side of the café and photograph the artwork that speaks to you most.
action_prompt: Hold a ten-second zen pose in front of your favorite piece.

title: Crate Digger
description: Lolo Reskin opened Sweat Records in 2005, and twenty years later it's still Miami's independent record store — right next to Churchill's Pub. Digging is the whole point: your next favorite album is in here somewhere.
quest_objective: Dig through the crates and find one record older than Sweat Records itself (2005). Photograph your find.
action_prompt: Air-drum one chorus of whatever record you found. Full commitment.

title: Shelf Discovery
description: Miami's iconic independent bookstore has anchored Coral Gables since 1982. Algorithms recommend what you already like — these shelves recommend what you didn't know existed.
quest_objective: Wander the flagship's shelves and find one book you'd never have discovered online. Photograph the cover where you found it.
action_prompt: Read your find's first sentence out loud to whoever came with you.

title: La Dolce Collins
description: An Italian bakery holding its corner of Collins Avenue since 2015, steps from Lincoln Road. The pastry case is the exhibit; admission is free.
quest_objective: Study the pastry counter and photograph the most Italian thing in the case.
action_prompt: Whisper 'che bello' at the pastry case like you truly mean it.

title: Mango State of Mind
description: A little South of Fifth spot with a name that promises shade, sweetness, and no hurry whatsoever. Slow down to South Beach walking pace and find out what the name means to you.
quest_objective: Find Under the Mango Tree just off Fifth Street and photograph whatever you think earned it the name.
action_prompt: Point at your photo subject and declare 'that's the mango tree' with total confidence.

title: The Dasher & Crank Riddle
description: The name is a riddle: what do a 'dasher' and a 'crank' have in common? Walk into this Wynwood shop and the answer becomes deliciously obvious.
quest_objective: Find Dasher & Crank on NW 2nd Ave and solve the name — the menu board is a good place to start. Photograph your evidence.
action_prompt: Guess the answer out loud before you walk in, then grade yourself at the counter.

title: Lost in the Grove
description: 'Midori' is Japanese for green — and this Main Highway spot sits in Miami's greenest neighborhood. Step inside and decide for yourself whether the name fits.
quest_objective: Find Midorie on Coconut Grove's Main Highway and photograph the greenest corner you can find.
action_prompt: Give your photo an art-gallery title and announce it out loud.

title: Meet Me at The Corner
description: A Park West bar that's exactly what it says on the sign. Downtown's night crowd has been meeting at this corner of N Miami Ave for years — now it's your turn.
quest_objective: Post up at The Corner and capture proof you found it — the sign, the room, or your spot at the bar.
action_prompt: Raise whatever you're holding and toast 'to the Corner.' Water counts.

title: Say 'Miam'
description: 'Miam' is French for 'yum' — the entire mission statement in four letters. Find the Wynwood café that named itself after the sound you make when the plate arrives.
quest_objective: Find Miam Café and photograph the thing on the menu that makes you go 'miam.'
action_prompt: Actually say 'miam' out loud when you spot it. It's the law of the quest.

title: Fill Up on Tapas
description: From the street it's a working Mobil gas station. Inside, since 1981, it's been a Spanish tapas and wine destination. This is the most Miami plot twist on Coral Way — and one of the city's great hidden doors.
quest_objective: Walk past the gas pumps and find the tapas-and-wine restaurant hiding inside. Photograph the exact spot where gas station turns into Spain.
action_prompt: Text a friend 'I'm at a gas station,' then send your photo with zero explanation.

title: Heaven on Brickell
description: The name means 'passion of heaven,' and it sits in the middle of Brickell's canyon of glass towers. Duck out of the financial district for ten minutes of the good stuff.
quest_objective: Find Pasión del Cielo on Brickell Ave and photograph its name where it appears — then add your own translation.
action_prompt: Salute the sky as you walk in. El cielo will understand.

title: Walls That Talk
description: An open-air museum where the galleries have no ceilings and the canvases are entire buildings. Timed entry tickets get you in the gates — curiosity does the rest.
quest_objective: Wander the outdoor galleries and find the mural that stops you mid-step. Photograph it, and hunt down the artist's name.
action_prompt: Match your pose to the mural. Yes, exactly like that.

title: Art on the Bay
description: PAMM sits at the water's edge of Maurice A. Ferré Park, next door to the Kaseya Center. Inside: contemporary art. Outside: Biscayne Bay doing its best to compete with it.
quest_objective: Find the one artwork inside PAMM you'd hang at home — then find the bay view and decide which one wins.
action_prompt: Leave a one-word review of your favorite piece in your Community Note.

title: Free Art, Big Ideas
description: A contemporary art museum in the Design District where admission is always free — and the museum is growing into the buildings next door. Zero dollars, maximum strangeness.
quest_objective: Walk in (it's free), explore a floor, and photograph the most wonderfully strange thing you find — where photos are allowed.
action_prompt: Later, describe that piece to a friend in exactly five words.

title: The Pastry Michelin Knows
description: Chef Antonio Bachour's Coral Gables bakery-restaurant carries a Michelin Bib Gourmand — the guide's nod for cooking that seriously over-delivers. The pastry display is the gallery; you're the jury.
quest_objective: Find Bachour on Salzedo St and photograph the pastry display — then pick the one you'd personally award a star.
action_prompt: Announce your winner with a full chef's kiss. Mwah.

title: Deco in Disguise
description: Architect L. Murray Dixon built this South Beach landmark in 1933; today it's a private event space hiding on quiet Euclid Avenue. You can't wander inside uninvited — but the Art Deco facade belongs to everyone.
quest_objective: Find the 1933 Temple House on Euclid Ave and photograph its Art Deco facade from the sidewalk.
action_prompt: Frame your shot like a 1930s postcard. Caption it 'Greetings from Miami Beach.'

title: The Club That Never Sleeps
description: A 24-hour ultraclub ranked among the best on the planet — Downtown Miami's round-the-clock heartbeat. Whatever hour you arrive, you're on time. 21+ only.
quest_objective: Make it to E11EVEN — any hour works, it never closes — and capture proof you found Miami's 24-hour ultraclub.
action_prompt: Caption your photo with the exact time you were there. Sunrise entries earn eternal respect.

title: Forty Floors Up
description: Ride to the 40th floor of EAST Miami and step into a Balinese-inspired rooftop garden floating over Brickell. Up here the skyline isn't the backdrop — it's the whole show.
quest_objective: Reach Sugar on EAST Miami's 40th floor and capture the Brickell skyline from the rooftop.
action_prompt: Point at the tallest tower you can see and calmly claim it as your future office.

title: A Little Something Extra
description: 'Lagniappe' is an old Louisiana word for a little unexpected bonus — and this award-winning wine bar and jazz house on the Wynwood-Edgewater border lives up to it, all the way to the garden out back.
quest_objective: Explore the house, find the garden, and settle in. Photograph your spot.
action_prompt: Use 'lagniappe' in a sentence on your way out. Bonus points if it lands naturally.

title: Drop the Needle
description: A vinyl listening bar in Wynwood where the records are the headliner. This is nightlife at 33⅓ RPM: sit down, tune in, and let someone else's crates change your taste.
quest_objective: Find Dante's HiFi and stay through at least one full song with your phone down. Then capture one discreet photo of the night.
action_prompt: Drop the song that was playing into your Community Note — future adventurers will thank you.

title: Step Inside the Art
description: In Allapattah, directly across from the Rubell Museum, Superblue trades picture frames for entire rooms. You don't look at this art — you walk into it.
quest_objective: Lose yourself in an immersive room and photograph the moment reality bends.
action_prompt: Take one photo where it's genuinely impossible to tell which way is up.

title: Island of Calm
description: An adults-only spa hideaway on Belle Isle, floating between Miami and Miami Beach. The quest is the journey: leave the mainland pace behind and find the island where wellness is the whole point.
quest_objective: Make your way onto Belle Isle and find the entrance to The Standard. Photograph your arrival.
action_prompt: Take one deep, dramatic spa breath at the entrance. In through the nose. You've earned it.

title: Dragon Hunting in Brickell
description: Named after the world's largest lizard and built to match, Komodo is Brickell dining at full spectacle. Come see why this corner of Brickell Avenue roars.
quest_objective: Track down Komodo on Brickell Ave and photograph the boldest detail of the space you can find.
action_prompt: Work your subtlest dragon impression into the photo. Subtle. We mean it.

title: Island Detour
description: Watson Island hides in plain sight between Downtown and South Beach — and Joia Beach is its shoreline reward. Cross the water, slow down, and catch the skyline from the sand side.
quest_objective: Find your way onto Watson Island and capture the Miami skyline from Joia Beach.
action_prompt: Shoes off for the photo. Mandatory? No. Correct? Absolutely.

title: Something's Fishy
description: With a name like Sexy Fish, subtlety was never the plan. This Brickell dining room goes all-in on glamour — come see how deep the theme swims.
quest_objective: Step into Sexy Fish on S Miami Ave and photograph the most extravagant detail you can find. There are contenders.
action_prompt: Name your photo like a perfume ad and share the title with your table.

title: Bass Notes
description: Miami Beach's contemporary art museum holds down Collins Park a couple of blocks from the sand. Ocean Drive gets the postcards; The Bass gets the ideas.
quest_objective: Explore The Bass and photograph two things: one artwork, and one detail of the building itself.
action_prompt: Give your favorite piece a one-word title and drop it in your Community Note.

title: Calle Ocho After Dark
description: On Calle Ocho, in the heart of Little Havana, Ball & Chain is where the neighborhood turns the volume up. Some bars you visit; this one you feel.
quest_objective: Find Ball & Chain on SW 8th Street and capture the moment that feels most alive.
action_prompt: Let your shoulders do a little salsa on the way in. Resistance is futile.

title: The Collectors' Warehouse
description: One family's contemporary art collection grew until it needed its own museum in Allapattah — right across the street from Superblue. Wander it like the world's most serious garage sale.
quest_objective: Explore the Rubell and find the artwork you'd smuggle home if no one were watching. Photograph it legally instead.
action_prompt: Estimate its price out loud. Then add three zeros.

title: The Vertical City
description: A shopping city stacked into the middle of Brickell, and still growing — its busiest month on record was as recent as April 2025. The stores are the excuse; the architecture is the reason.
quest_objective: Explore Brickell City Centre's levels and photograph the view where the architecture steals the show from the shops.
action_prompt: Window-shop one store wildly outside your budget with complete confidence.

title: Where Downtown Meets the Bay
description: Downtown's waterfront marketplace, where the shopping ends at the edge of Biscayne Bay. Skip the mall part first — go straight to the water and work backwards.
quest_objective: Find the spot where Bayside meets the bay and capture the water, boats and skyline in one frame.
action_prompt: Wave at a passing boat. If they wave back, it counts double.

title: Six Ways Lucky
description: Miami's first Asian food hall: 10,000 square feet in Wynwood holding six kitchens under one roof. One address, six chances your night improves.
quest_objective: Walk the full hall and find all six food concepts. Photograph the counter or dish you'd try first.
action_prompt: Spin once on your heel and let fate point you to a counter.

title: Postcard Row
description: Seventy-four acres of oceanfront park running along Ocean Drive through the Art Deco Historic District. Palms on one side, pastel architecture on the other — the most photographed stretch of Miami Beach, waiting for your version.
quest_objective: Walk the stretch where Lummus Park's palms meet the Art Deco skyline and capture the most Miami photo possible.
action_prompt: Add a flamingo pose. One leg. You know the one.

title: The Palm Court Puzzle
description: A whole neighborhood curated like a gallery — luxury storefronts, public art and architecture competing politely for your attention. Somewhere in the middle hides Palm Court, the district's gathering spot.
quest_objective: Explore the district's public spaces until you find Palm Court. Photograph the storefront or installation that stopped you along the way.
action_prompt: Pick the display window that best matches your personality. Defend your choice.

title: City Under Construction
description: Ten blocks of Park West being rebuilt into a brand-new district — towers, promenades and street-level retail rising in real time. Walk it now and you'll be able to say you saw it happen.
quest_objective: Walk Miami Worldcenter's new blocks and photograph old Miami and new Miami in a single frame.
action_prompt: Record a five-second voice memo predicting what this block looks like in ten years.

title: The Half-Mile Miracle
description: Coral Gables' signature stretch of Coral Way — half a mile of storefronts with a very confident name. Walk it end to end and issue your own verdict.
quest_objective: Walk Miracle Mile from one end to the other and photograph your favorite storefront along the way.
action_prompt: Deliver your verdict in a Community Note: does it earn the name 'Miracle'?

title: Home Court
description: The 23,000-square-foot East Plaza outside Kaseya Center is Downtown's pre-game front porch — and on quiet days, a bayfront shortcut with an arena-sized backdrop. Game night or ghost town, the Heat's house is worth the walk.
quest_objective: Find the East Plaza at Kaseya Center and capture the arena where the Heat play — game day or not.
action_prompt: Practice your championship-parade wave across the plaza.

title: The Wild Side of Watson Island
description: An eco-adventure park on Watson Island, minutes from Downtown and open daily. Skyscrapers on one horizon, jungle canopy on the other — Miami's weirdest, wildest border crossing.
quest_objective: Explore Jungle Island and photograph the most tropical resident you meet.
action_prompt: Imitate the call of the loudest bird you hear. Commit fully.

title: The Pedestrian's Feast
description: Coral Gables closed this block of Giralda Avenue to cars in 2017 and handed it to dinner tables. It's downtown's open-air dining room — walk it slow.
quest_objective: Stroll pedestrian-only Giralda Plaza end to end and photograph the table you'd claim on a Friday night.
action_prompt: Rate the plaza's people-watching out of ten. Out loud.

title: Through the Portal
description: A 33,000-square-foot open plaza in the Design District, home to Criola's 'Interdimensional Portal' mural. As advertised: it's a portal. Interdimensionally speaking.
quest_objective: Find Criola's 'Interdimensional Portal' mural at Jungle Plaza and step through it — photographically speaking.
action_prompt: Pose like you're mid-teleport. Hair matters here.

title: Eat Like a Commuter
description: A food hall built into Brightline's MiamiCentral station, where intercity trains and lunch counters share a roof. The rare place where 'grabbing a bite before the train' is the destination.
quest_objective: Find the food hall inside MiamiCentral station and photograph the scene — trains, counters and all.
action_prompt: Time your photo to a Brightline arrival if you can. Patience is a virtue.

title: The Museum's Front Yard
description: Thirty acres of downtown waterfront green, renamed in 2019 for Miami's former mayor — with PAMM and the Frost Science Museum living inside it. Culture on one side, Biscayne Bay on the other, grass in between.
quest_objective: Walk the park's waterfront and frame one photo with the bay on one side and the museums on the other.
action_prompt: Find the best patch of grass and claim it for exactly one minute of doing absolutely nothing.

title: The Spanish Detour
description: A historic Mediterranean-style pedestrian street tucked between Washington and Drexel, freshly restored and permanently unhurried. Two blocks of South Beach that decided to be Spain instead.
quest_objective: Wander Española Way and photograph the detail that feels imported straight from the Mediterranean.
action_prompt: Bid the street 'buenas noches' when you leave — time of day irrelevant.

title: Dinner Key Discovery
description: Coconut Grove's waterfront hub on historic Dinner Key — marina, dining and bay breeze run by people who clearly understand what the Grove is for. Come watch the masts sway.
quest_objective: Explore Regatta Harbour and photograph the spot where the Grove meets the water — boats required in frame.
action_prompt: Pick the boat you'd captain and christen it out loud with a brand-new name.

title: The Crossroads
description: Since 1984 this has been Miami's great transit crossroads — Metrorail, Metromover and Metrobus all converging in one Downtown hub. Most people pass through; this time, stop and look.
quest_objective: Find where the trains come and go at Government Center and capture one in motion.
action_prompt: Guess where a departing train is headed, then check the board and grade yourself.

title: High Tea, Literally
description: Forty floors above Brickell, open only Thursday through Saturday, hides an Asian-inspired cocktail lounge called the Tea Room. Part speakeasy, part skybox — all timing.
quest_objective: On a Thursday, Friday or Saturday, ride up EAST Miami and find the Tea Room on the 40th floor. Capture your proof.
action_prompt: Toast with pinkies out. It is a tea room, after all.

title: The Secret Garden of the Grove
description: A historic Coconut Grove estate that became one of only five gardens in the National Tropical Botanical Garden network. Most of its cousins are in Hawaii; this one hides behind Douglas Road.
quest_objective: Explore The Kampong's grounds and photograph the tree or plant that looks most like it escaped from a storybook.
action_prompt: Learn one plant's name before you leave and formally introduce it to your group.

title: Small Press, Big Energy
description: Miami's independent zine shop moved from Little River to the Design District in 2024, carrying its universe of small-press treasures with it. Every shelf is somebody's whole heart, photocopied.
quest_objective: Find Dale Zine's Design District home and browse until you find a zine you've never heard of. Photograph the cover.
action_prompt: Greet the shop with a proper Miami 'dale!' on your way in.

title: The Garden of Little Haiti
description: A Little Haiti original with 'garden' right there in the name — the kind of neighborhood restaurant that grew a second location without losing its roots. Come find the original.
quest_objective: Find Naomi's Garden on NW 71st Street and photograph whatever earns the 'garden' in the name.
action_prompt: Compliment the plants. Out loud. They've earned it.

title: The Pop-Up That Stayed
description: It started as a pop-up in 2012 inside the Freehand Miami — then earned a James Beard semifinalist nod and simply never left. Some experiments succeed so hard they become institutions.
quest_objective: Find the Broken Shaker inside the Freehand and settle into the bar that refused to be temporary. Capture your spot.
action_prompt: Raise a toast to every pop-up that outlived its own concept.

title: The Hundred-Year Dive
description: Established 1926: Miami Beach's oldest bar turns one hundred this year. Cash only, no pretense, beloved by Anthony Bourdain — a century of South Beach history in one room.
quest_objective: Step into Mac's Club Deuce and salute the century. Capture proof you stood in Miami's oldest bar. Bring cash — that's the house rule.
action_prompt: Ask yourself what this room has seen in 100 years. Put your best guess in a Community Note.

title: The Gas Station That Grew
description: Artist Paloma Teppa turned a 1960s gas station on the banks of the Little River into a biophilic art studio and gallery. Where fuel pumps once stood, a small indoor jungle now runs the place.
quest_objective: Find the converted gas station on NE 2nd Ave and photograph the spot where art and plants blur together completely.
action_prompt: Visually adopt one plant, name it, and record the adoption in your Community Note.

title: The Landmark Across the Way
description: A Mediterranean Revival landmark on the National Register of Historic Places, standing directly across from the Biltmore. One of Coral Gables' founding-era beauties — and most people drive right past it.
quest_objective: Find the church on De Soto Blvd and photograph your favorite Mediterranean Revival detail of the building.
action_prompt: Bonus challenge: frame the church and the Biltmore in a single shot.

title: Flagler Street Revival
description: A cocktail bar and gastropub inside the historic Alfred I. duPont Building, where old Flagler Street grandeur meets new Downtown energy. The name is a question; the room is the answer.
quest_objective: Find Over Under on E Flagler Street and capture where the historic building meets the modern bar.
action_prompt: Debate with your group: is the name about drinks, sports bets, or the building? Pick a side and die on it.

title: Get Lost Downtown
description: An English-pub-style bar that opened in 2018 inside the Alfred I. duPont Building — 'Lost Boy Dry Goods,' a pub wearing a general store's name on historic Flagler Street. Getting lost here is the point.
quest_objective: Find Lost Boy Dry Goods on E Flagler Street and photograph the most un-pub-like detail of this very English pub.
action_prompt: Declare yourself officially lost upon entry — and found by the time you leave.

title: Rainforest Within the Garden
description: Inside Fairchild's 83 acres hides the Richard H. Simons Rainforest — two acres of canopy, streams and a waterfall, growing since 2001. A rainforest, inside a garden, inside Miami.
quest_objective: Find the Simons Rainforest inside Fairchild and photograph the waterfall tucked within it.
action_prompt: Narrate what you see in your best nature-documentary whisper.

title: The Porta-Potty Portal
description: By day it reads as a taqueria. But since 2014, South Beach regulars have known the truth: somewhere inside stands a fake porta-potty door, and behind it, a hidden bar. Yes, really. No, not a real porta-potty. Go find it.
quest_objective: Find the fake porta-potty door inside Bodega and discover what's behind it. Photograph the door — leave what's beyond it a mystery.
action_prompt: Walk in acting completely casual. Fail completely.

title: The 2,000-Year-Old Circle
description: In 1998, construction at the mouth of the Miami River uncovered a perfect circle of ancient postholes — a Tequesta site up to 2,700 years old. Skyscrapers rose around it; the circle stayed. It's now a public park on the Riverwalk.
quest_objective: Walk the Riverwalk to Brickell Point and find the Miami Circle. Photograph where the city's oldest story meets its newest skyline.
action_prompt: Turn one slow, full 360° where you stand — one circle for the Circle.
